name: 94561 · Oakley, CA
findings: ZIP 94561 (Oakley) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94561 (Oakley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94561 (Oakley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
